purpose: Paradox Forge beta/development fixture library. DIM payloads are sanitised and contain no item instance IDs.

fixtures.buildFocus: Void invisibility access: Vanishing Step supplies invisibility that Stylish Executioner uses for its post-execution weakening melee.

synergyChains.evidence: Bungie A Closer Look at Void 3.0: Vanishing Step makes the Hunter invisible on dodge; Stylish Executioner states that while invisible after a Stylish Execution, the next melee weakens enemies. Fixture equips both hashes 187655373 and 187655374.

knownStrengths.statement: The equipped aspects provide verified invisibility access, with Stylish Executioner also converting its invisibility state into a weakening melee.
knownStrengths.evidence: Bungie A Closer Look at Void 3.0: Vanishing Step dodges grant invisibility; Stylish Executioner grants invisibility from Void-debuffed defeats and its next melee while invisible weakens.

fixtures.buildFocus: Solar sustain through Healing Grenade Restoration with Ember of Empyrean extending Restoration on Solar defeats.

synergyChains.evidence: Manifest-derived Healing Grenade hash 1841016428 grants restoration to allies when its Orb is picked up. Bungie TWID 2024-02-15 documents Ember of Empyrean extending Restoration/Radiant duration on Solar defeats. Fixture equips Ember of Empyrean hash 362132294.

knownStrengths.statement: Verified Restoration sustain path from Healing Grenade into Ember of Empyrean duration extension.
knownStrengths.evidence: Healing Grenade manifest description grants Restoration; Bungie TWID 2024-02-15 documents Ember of Empyrean Restoration duration extension on Solar defeats.

mutationCases.evidence: Both grenade hashes occur inside the 23-fixture Alpha library. Healing Grenade explicitly grants Restoration; Fusion Grenade hash 1013086087 is described as an attaching grenade that damages and scorches, not as a Restoration source.

fixtures.buildFocus: Arc jolt conversion: Tempest Strike supplies jolt and Lethal Current converts melee contact with a jolted target into blind.

synergyChains.evidence: Bungie Bring the Thunder: Inside Arc 3.0 documents Tempest Strike as a sliding melee that launches an Arc wave which jolts enemies, and Lethal Current as blinding a jolted enemy when that target is damaged with melee. Fixture equips hashes 4194622037 and 4194622038.

knownStrengths.statement: Tempest Strike supplies the jolted-target state that Lethal Current can convert into blind through melee contact.
knownStrengths.evidence: Bungie Bring the Thunder: Inside Arc 3.0 describes Tempest Strike jolt and Lethal Current's melee interaction with jolted targets.

mutationCases.evidence: Both Lethal Current hash 4194622038 and Flow State hash 4194622036 occur in the Alpha fixture library. Removing Lethal Current removes the curated Tempest Strike -> jolt -> Lethal Current endpoint even though Flow State can form a different jolt relationship.

fixtures.buildFocus: Arc jolt-to-amplified loop: Tempest Strike jolts targets and Flow State activates when a jolted opponent is defeated.

synergyChains.evidence: Bungie Bring the Thunder: Inside Arc 3.0 states Tempest Strike launches an Arc wave that jolts enemies and Flow State makes the Hunter amplified after defeating a jolted opponent. Fixture socket data equips hashes 4194622037 and 4194622036.

knownStrengths.statement: Tempest Strike provides a verified jolt source for Flow State's jolted-opponent defeat condition.
knownStrengths.evidence: Bungie Bring the Thunder: Inside Arc 3.0 documents both Tempest Strike jolt and Flow State's trigger.

fixtures.buildFocus: Prismatic ability-final-blow pressure: Grapple melee defeats can contribute to Gunpowder Gamble progress.

synergyChains.evidence: Manifest-derived Grapple hash 1225978592 includes a Grapple melee that deals area damage. Bungie Update 9.0.0.1 states Gunpowder Gamble final blows of all kinds grant progress; therefore a Grapple melee final blow is a qualifying input, without asserting that every Grapple use gets a final blow.

knownStrengths.statement: Grapple melee final blows are a verified source of Gunpowder Gamble progress.
knownStrengths.evidence: Grapple manifest description defines the damaging melee; Bungie Update 9.0.0.1 states all final blows grant Gunpowder Gamble progress.

fixtures.buildFocus: Strand Grapple chaining through Grapple Tangles and Widow's Silk free grapples.

synergyChains.evidence: Manifest-derived Grapple hash 2470512752 defines Grapple/Grapple melee. Bungie Update 9.5.0 states that with Widow's Silk, hitting an enemy with a non-free grapple melee creates a Grapple Tangle and looking at a Grapple Tangle overrides the grenade with a free grapple.

knownStrengths.statement: Widow's Silk provides a verified path from a paid Grapple melee into a Grapple Tangle and then a free Grapple.
knownStrengths.evidence: Bungie Update 9.5.0 Widow's Silk/Grapple Tangle changes.

knownStrengths.statement: Grapple melee final blows are a verified source of Gunpowder Gamble progress.

fixtures.buildFocus: Prismatic ignition amplification: Hailfire Spike creates an ignition and Facet of Ruin increases Solar Ignition size.

synergyChains.evidence: Bungie Prismatic Deep Dive/manifest Hailfire Spike: after a short duration the device ignites and creates a scorching cyclone. Bungie Prismatic Deep Dive: Facet of Ruin increases the size of Solar Ignitions. Fixture equips Facet of Ruin hash 124726499.

knownStrengths.statement: Hailfire Spike's verified ignition is directly enhanced by the equipped Facet of Ruin.
knownStrengths.evidence: Bungie Prismatic Deep Dive describes both Hailfire Spike ignition and Facet of Ruin increasing Solar Ignition size.

fixtures.buildFocus: Prismatic Threadling loop: Threadling Grenade creates Threadlings whose Strand final blows can feed Weaver's Call's perched-Threadling generation.

synergyChains.evidence: Manifest-derived Threadling Grenade hash 3994381207 creates Threadlings. Bungie Inside Strand establishes Threadlings as damaging summons, and Destiny 2 Update 8.0.0.1 states Weaver's Call can generate a perched Threadling when a target is defeated with Strand damage, explicitly including damage from other Threadlings.

knownStrengths.statement: Threadling Grenade supplies Threadlings whose Strand-damage defeats can feed Weaver's Call into additional perched Threadlings.
knownStrengths.evidence: Threadling Grenade manifest description; Bungie Inside Strand; Destiny 2 Update 8.0.0.1 Weaver's Call behavior.

mutationCases.evidence: Threadling Grenade hash 3994381207 and Storm Grenade hash 4241856103 both occur within the Alpha fixture library. Swapping away Threadling Grenade removes the curated Threadling Strand-damage producer endpoint feeding Weaver's Call.

fixtures.buildFocus: Solar Fusion Grenade enhancement through Touch of Flame.

synergyChains.evidence: Bungie TWID 2025-07-31 explicitly describes Fusion Grenades as being enhanced by Touch of Flame and documents tuning to the damage of Fusion grenades when enhanced by the aspect. Fixture equips Touch of Flame hash 83039193 and Fusion Grenade hash 1013086087.

knownStrengths.statement: Touch of Flame is a verified direct enhancer of the equipped Fusion Grenade.
knownStrengths.evidence: Bungie TWID 2025-07-31 explicitly refers to Fusion grenades enhanced by Touch of Flame.

fixtures.buildFocus: Void Scatter Grenade loop: Chaos Accelerant directly enhances Scatter Grenade, whose Void-ability final blows can activate Feed the Void and Devour.

synergyChains.evidence: Bungie TWID 2025-09-11 and the corresponding Update 9.1.5 tuning document Chaos Accelerant's charged Scatter Grenade creating additional seekers, gaining combatant damage, improved tracking, and lifetime. Fixture equips Chaos Accelerant hash 2321824285 and Scatter Grenade hash 1514173218.

Manifest-derived Scatter Grenade is a Void grenade that deals damage through multiple explosions. Bungie A Closer Look at Void 3.0 documents Feed the Void as activating Devour after defeating an enemy with a Void ability; therefore a Scatter Grenade final blow is a qualifying input.

knownStrengths.statement: Chaos Accelerant directly enhances the equipped Scatter Grenade, and Scatter Grenade final blows can activate Feed the Void/Devour.
knownStrengths.evidence: Bungie TWID 2025-09-11 Chaos Accelerant Scatter tuning; Scatter Grenade manifest description; Bungie A Closer Look at Void 3.0 Feed the Void trigger.

mutationCases.evidence: Scatter Grenade hash 1514173218 and Magnetic Grenade hash 1547656727 occur inside the Alpha fixture library. Replacing Scatter Grenade removes the exact curated Chaos Accelerant -> enhanced Scatter Grenade endpoint.

fixtures.buildFocus: Prismatic ability-kill sustain: Storm Grenade final blows are qualifying ability defeats for Feed the Void, establishing Devour.

synergyChains.evidence: Manifest-derived Storm Grenade hash 4241856103 is a damaging Arc grenade. Bungie Dev Insights: Prismatic Deep Dive states Feed the Void activates from ability defeats of any damage type on Prismatic Warlock; therefore a Storm Grenade final blow is a qualifying input.

knownStrengths.statement: The equipped Storm Grenade can directly satisfy Prismatic Feed the Void's any-ability defeat trigger.
knownStrengths.evidence: Storm Grenade manifest description; Bungie Dev Insights: Prismatic Deep Dive Feed the Void any-damage-type ability defeat rule.

Manifest-derived Well of Radiance hash 2274196887 states its aura grants radiant effects and restoration to nearby allies. Bungie TWID 2024-02-15 documents Ember of Empyrean Restoration/Radiant duration extension on Solar defeats.

knownStrengths.statement: Two equipped sources can establish Restoration before Ember of Empyrean extends its duration: Healing Grenade and Well of Radiance.

knownStrengths.statement: Arc Soul defeats are a verified Arc-ability source for charging Ionic Sentry.
knownStrengths.evidence: Bungie TWID 2025-01-16 Ionic Sentry charge rule plus TWID 2025-09-11 construct-as-grenade classification for Arc Soul.
